images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a Chilean high-school lesson website about AI, money and the future of technical work. Primary request: a polished colorful dimensional paper-cut editorial scene: two young Chilean vocational students looking at an open notebook together, with a small friendly abstract neural chip, a bank card and coins, and a precise industrial robot arm as visual metaphors around them. Mature visual style for 17-18 year olds, no childish robots. Landscape 3:2 composition, main subjects centered, uncluttered balanced shapes, warm off-white backdrop, deep cobalt blue, turquoise, coral orange and buttery yellow palette. Soft tactile paper textures and subtle 3D depth, crisp forms. No text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks. Conceptual illustration, not a news photo, no identifiable real people.
images.purpose: Ilustración conceptual de acompañamiento; no es evidencia de las noticias.
